title: Turn over time
prompt: The robot faces angle degrees and turns at turn_speed degrees per second. Return the angle after one frame. From 0 at 90 per second, a 0.5 s frame gives 45.
starter:
func solve(angle, turn_speed, delta) -> float:
	return angle

tests.name: 0 plus 90 per second for 0.5 s is 45

hints: Degrees per second times seconds gives degrees.
solution:
func solve(angle, turn_speed, delta) -> float:
	return angle + turn_speed * delta
